# اِعْتَكَدْتَ (iʕtakadta) /iʕ.ta.kad.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# اِعْتَكَدْتِ (iʕtakadti) /iʕ.ta.kad.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# اِعْتَكَدَتْ (iʕtakadat) /iʕ.ta.ka.dat/: third-perso
